Stage 2 · Working mechanisms

Drive it and watch the machinery respond

One shared state drives everything below and the parts glowing in the drawing. Nothing turns unless something upstream drives it. Motion is slowed 60 times so you can follow it; the numbers are real-time.

Power flow

    Stage 3 · Agricultural systems

    Lift, hitch and power an implement

    The same shared state as above. The engine drives the hydraulic pump and the PTO, so start the engine first. Lowering works with the engine off because the implement's own weight pushes the oil out.

    Field mode

    PTO lever

    PTO turning. A spinning shaft can catch a sleeve or a lace and pull you in within a fraction of a second. Keep every guard fitted, wear close-fitting clothes, and stop the engine and take out the key before going near it.
